summary: Milestoneごとのcheckpoint(進捗fileと小さなgit commit、機械可読な機能/受入リスト)と、Fable 5向けの'context残量で止まらない/進捗はtool結果に接地'指示で、再読・全工程やり直し・早期終了を減らし、人間が常時監視せずに再開できる状態を作る。

evidence.summary: Anthropic長時間harness: `claude-progress.txt`進捗log、'commit its progress to git with descriptive commit messages'でrevert/回復、feature listをJSONで`passes`だけ更新、'work on only one feature at a time'、`init.sh`でsession立上げ。'declares victory early'対策としてfeature list

'Rare cases of context-budget concern': 残量表示を避け、必要なら'You have ample context remaining. Do not stop, summarize, or suggest a new session...'; 'Ground progress claims': tool結果に接地させる指示で捏造statusをほぼ排除(Anthropic内部test); memory systemはMarkdown fileで十分
auto memoryとMEMORY.md index。session横断のbuild/debug知見保持
Codex compaction後に実行状態を失う(candidate/medium)。project-local durable stateへの記録が回復controlとして記載

obra/superpowers@subagent-driven-development (public, reputation established): read skills/subagent-driven-development/SKILL.md at HEAD, Setup section: 'Conversation memory does not survive compaction. In real sessions, controllers that lost their place have re-dispatched entire completed task sequences — the single most expensive failure observed. Track progress in a ledger file, not only in todos.' The ledger lives at <repo-root>/.superpowers/sdd/<plan>/progress.md with the plan path as its first line; tasks carrying 'Task <N>: complete' are not re-dispatched and the controller resumes at the first task without one, a task ending mid fix-round resumes at the next round, and 'the commits it names exist in git even when your context no longer remembers creating them. After compaction, trust the ledger and git log over your own recollection.'

applies_when: 数十分以上・複数段階の作業、session跨ぎ、compactionが起きうるrun
失敗時に最初からやり直す・同じfileを再読する傾向が観測される
not_applicable_when: 数分で終わる単発変更(checkpoint自体がoverhead)
commitを許可されていないworkflow(進捗fileだけ使う)
applicability.model_conditions: model-agnostic; context-budget/early-stop文言はFable 5固有の公式推奨

expected_effect.primary: 再開costと再読の削減、未完終了・全損の防止
metrics: 失敗後の再開に要したturn数
checkpoint数 vs 途中終了時の残作業量

risks: 進捗fileがrepositoryを汚す(scratchpad/.steering等の置場を決める)
commit粒度が細かすぎるとhistoryが荒れる
cost: 進捗file規約と数行の指示。既存.steeringを再利用可
known_failure_modes: 残token countdownをmodelに見せる(公式: 早期終了trigger)
進捗fileを更新せず会話内だけで状態管理→compactionで消える
'完了'を自己申告させるだけでtool証拠を求めない
revalidate_when: Fable 5後継でcontext挙動が変わった

alternates.why_not_primary: Previous primary, demoted on reputation: the repo has 0 stars and 0 forks with 32 installs. Its design remains the closest to the remedy's machine-readable acceptance list — an Initializer sub-agent generating a YAML feature list, runbook, backlog and progress file under _working/, then one work unit per session with a commit.

evidence: first pass reported 32 installs on skills.sh

alternates.why_not_primary: Established; supplies the machine-readable half — plans committed under docs/superpowers/plans/ with `- [ ]` checkbox steps sized so each ends in an independently testable deliverable and a commit — but it writes the plan rather than executing and checkpointing it.

evidence: read skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md at HEAD (checkbox task syntax, bite-sized steps ending in Commit, plans committed under docs/superpowers/plans/)

alternates.why_not_primary: Persists requirements/design/tasklist under .steering/ with rules against marking unfinished tasks done, so it substitutes for the progress file, but prescribes no git checkpoint commits, no per-milestone loop and nothing about context-budget or early-stop wording. Non-public, so never reader-facing.
